Task: gate-obsidian-backfill-behind-export-ledger
Working directory: /tmp/nix-shell.0oeQ1o/visual-relay/wt/28b9d4518058/plan-20260717214128/gate-obsidian-backfill-behind-export-ledger
Protected paths (queue bookkeeping — never part of this task's diff): llm-tasks/, .relay/, .relay-scratch/, .swival/

## Task input
## Task: Gate Obsidian summary back-fill behind a per-repo export ledger

The bridge's reconcile pass (`ReconcileExportsAsync`,
`MainWindowViewModel.ObsidianBridge.cs:143-162`) writes a vault note for
every completed task whose note is missing, keyed only on
`File.Exists(SummaryPath(id, date))`. That single dedupe rule produces
three confirmed defects:

1. **Fabricated notes for tasks Visual Relay never ran.** A completed task
   with no `.relay/<id>/stage*.report.json` yields an empty
   `TaskRunMetric`, so the note claims `$0.00` cost, `0s` duration, status
   `committed` (the `ResolveStatus` default with a null outcome and no
   status record) and `vr-completed-at` = the scan moment (tier-3 `nowUtc`
   fallback, `ObsidianSummaryWriter.cs:250`).
2. **Daily duplicates of those notes.** With no stage metrics, the
   date-folder for both the existence check
   (`MainWindowViewModel.ObsidianBridge.cs:153-155`) and the write resolves
   to "today" — so each new UTC day the check misses and a fresh copy lands
   in the new date folder, for as long as the task stays in the top-50 of
   `ListCompletedAsync`.
3. **Deleted notes resurrect.** The operator deliberately deletes notes
   from the vault; for any top-50 completed task the next idle scan
   (~poll interval) re-creates the note — and the re-created copy is
   degraded (null outcome → empty `vr-commit`, no flag reason).

### Evidence (verified)

- 2026-07-17, two independent instances fabricated the same five notes for
  the manually-archived test-speedup set (completed outside the pipeline by
  hand, commit 9bb02d9, 2026-07-09; zero `.relay/<id>` artifacts exist in
  git history): one instance at 07:42:44Z, another at 21:04:04Z into a
  second vault. Signature in every one: `committed · $0.00 · 0s`,
  `vr-completed-at` = scan time, empty `vr-commit`/`vr-source-guid`.
- The back-fill is LOAD-BEARING and must not be removed: drains run on a
  different machine than the vault-owning app, so the vault owner's
  completion-time export (`ExportSummaryOnCompletion`) never fires for
  drained tasks. Its vault is populated exclusively by this reconcile pass
  reading the committed stage reports after a git sync. A single first
  scan against an empty vault correctly produced the full
  `Completed/<date>/` tree for all metric-having tasks (observed
  2026-07-17 21:04Z) — that behavior must survive.
- Operator requirement: manually deleted notes must STAY deleted. The
  current file-existence dedupe cannot distinguish "never exported" from
  "deleted on purpose".

### What to build

1. **Export ledger.** A hidden per-repo ledger file inside the vault repo
   folder (dot-prefixed so Obsidian ignores it, e.g.
   `<vault>/<repo>/.vr-export-ledger.json`) recording the task ids that
   have ever had a summary exported. Both export paths append on every
   successful write: `ExportSummaryOnCompletion` and the reconcile
   back-fill. Atomic replace on save (temp file + rename).
2. **Back-fill gate.** Reconcile writes a note only when the task id is
   NOT in the ledger AND the task has at least one stage report
   (`metric.Stages.Count > 0`). Tasks with no run record are never
   back-filled — nothing is fabricated (fixes defect 1) and no date
   arithmetic ever falls back to "now" (fixes defect 2). A note whose id
   is in the ledger is never re-created, so deletions stick (fixes
   defect 3).
3. **First-scan seeding.** When the ledger file is absent:
   - vault repo folder has NO existing `Completed/**/*.md` notes → fresh
     vault: back-fill every metric-having completed task once (today's
     load-bearing population), recording each in the new ledger;
   - existing notes found → pre-ledger vault: seed the ledger with EVERY
     currently-completed task id without writing a single note. History is
     settled; only tasks that complete after seeding get exported.
   An unreadable/corrupt ledger is treated as absent.

### Constraints

- Do not change note content or the completion-time export behavior for
  tasks that ran. Do not touch the importer or scaffold.
- Egress guards stay: task-id validation before any vault path is
  composed; the ledger lives at a fixed name, never composed from task
  ids.
- Repo-agnostic; keep files under the 300-line guard; TimeProvider (no
  real-time waits) in tests.

### Tests (red first)

- Completed task with no `.relay/<id>`: scan writes no note, ledger gains
  nothing — fails today (fabricated `$0.00 · 0s · committed` note).
- Metric-less completed task, scans on two consecutive UTC days
  (TimeProvider): zero notes both days — fails today (one copy per day).
- Metric-having task whose note was deleted after export (id in ledger):
  scan does not re-create it — fails today (resurrection).
- Fresh vault, no ledger, no notes: one scan back-fills all metric-having
  completed tasks at their metric-derived dates and writes the ledger —
  pins the load-bearing population path.
- Vault with notes but no ledger: scan writes no new notes and seeds the
  ledger with all completed ids — fails today (missing notes get
  back-filled).
- Completion-time export records its task id in the ledger.
- Corrupt ledger file: treated as absent, seeding rules apply, no crash.

### Verification

- `./visual-relay check` fully green including the new tests.
- Manual: scratch repo + scratch vault. (1) Fresh vault scan populates
  notes and the ledger. (2) Delete one note, rescan: stays deleted.
  (3) Archive a task by hand with no `.relay/<id>`, rescan across a
  simulated day change: no note ever appears. (4) Delete the ledger,
  rescan: no new notes, ledger reseeded.

Now I have everything I need. Here is the concrete plan:

---

## Plan

### Overview

Add a per-repo `ExportLedger` that records every task id ever exported, then gate the bridge reconcile pass behind it. Two files created, one modified. No changes to `ObsidianSummaryWriter`, `ObsidianVaultLayout`, `RelayRunHistory`, or the importer/scaffold.

---

### 1. New file: `+src/VisualRelay.Core/ObsidianBridge/ExportLedger.cs` (~130 lines)

An `ExportLedger` class and `ExportLedgerSeedResult` enum.

**`ExportLedgerSeedResult` enum** (3 values):
- `Skip` — ledger exists and is valid; normal operation.
- `FullBackfill` — no ledger, no `Completed/**/*.md` notes; the caller should back-fill every metric-having completed task, recording each in the new ledger.
- `SealOnly` — no ledger but existing notes found; the ledger is already seeded with all completed ids; the caller writes nothing.

**`ExportLedger` class**:
- Constructor takes `string repoDir`; the ledger path is `Path.Combine(repoDir, ".vr-export-ledger.json")` — a fixed name, never composed from task ids.
- **`ContainsAsync(taskId, ct)`**: loads the ledger JSON (a sorted `string[]` of task ids), returns `true` if `taskId` is present. Returns `false` when the file is absent or corrupt.
- **`RecordAsync(taskId, ct)`**: loads existing ids (or empty set if absent/corrupt), adds `taskId`, atomically saves via temp-file + rename. Idempotent.
- **`RecordBatchAsync(taskIds, ct)`**: same as Record but for a batch — loads once, adds all, saves once.
- **`TrySeedAsync(layout, allCompletedTaskIds, ct)`**:
  1. If the ledger file exists AND can be parsed successfully → return `Skip`.
  2. If the file exists but is corrupt JSON → treat as absent (fall through to step 3).
  3. Check whether `Completed/**/*.md` notes exist (any `.md` not `INFO.md`):
     - **Notes exist** → `RecordBatchAsync(allCompletedTaskIds)`, return `SealOnly`.
     - **No notes** → save an empty array (fresh ledger), return `FullBackfill`.
- **Internal helpers**: `LoadAsync` → `HashSet<string>` (handles missing file, corrupt JSON → empty set), `SaveAsync` → atomic temp+rename, `HasCompletedNotes(layout)` → checks `Completed/` tree.

The writer (`ObsidianSummaryWriter`) is **untouched** — all gating lives in the bridge VM and the ledger.

---

### 2. Modify: `src/VisualRelay.App/ViewModels/MainWindowViewModel.ObsidianBridge.cs` (+~20 lines, ~242 total)

**`ReconcileExportsAsync`** (lines 143–162) rewritten:

```csharp
private async Task ReconcileExportsAsync(ObsidianVaultLayout layout)
{
    var repository = new RelayTaskRepository(RootPath);
    var writer = new ObsidianSummaryWriter();
    var ledger = new ExportLedger(layout.RepoDir);

    var completedTasks = await repository.ListCompletedAsync();
    var seedResult = await ledger.TrySeedAsync(
        layout, completedTasks.Select(t => t.Id).ToList());

    if (seedResult == ExportLedgerSeedResult.SealOnly)
        return; // pre-ledger vault — history settled, write nothing

    // FullBackfill: all tasks; Skip: top-50 only
    var candidates = seedResult == ExportLedgerSeedResult.FullBackfill
        ? completedTasks
        : completedTasks.Take(50);

    foreach (var task in candidates)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(task.MarkdownPath) || !File.Exists(task.MarkdownPath))
            continue;

        if (await ledger.ContainsAsync(task.Id))
            continue;

        var metric = RelayRunHistory.ReadTaskMetric(RootPath, task.Id);
        if (metric.Stages.Count == 0)
            continue; // ← defect 1 & 2 fix: never back-fill tasks with no run record

        var spec = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(task.MarkdownPath);
        writer.Write(layout, RootPath, task.Id, null, spec, null, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow);
        await ledger.RecordAsync(task.Id);
    }
}
```

Key changes from the old code:
- The old `File.Exists(layout.SummaryPath(task.Id, date))` dedupe is replaced by `ledger.ContainsAsync(task.Id)` (fixes defect 3: deleted notes stay deleted).
- The old date-resolution fallback to `UtcNow.Date` is removed — the gate `metric.Stages.Count == 0` skips the task entirely before any date is computed (fixes defect 1: no fabricated `$0.00 · 0s · committed` notes, fixes defect 2: no date-fallback means no daily duplicates).
- The old `null` outcome and `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow` call at line 160 are preserved exactly — the writer still receives them for tasks that pass the gate (these tasks have real run data, so the outcome inference from status record produces a correct status).

**`ExportSummaryOnCompletion`** (lines 167–179): add 3 lines after the `writer.Write(...)` call:

```csharp
// Record in export ledger so reconcile never re-creates this note.
await new ExportLedger(layout.RepoDir).RecordAsync(taskId);
```

This sits inside the existing `try` block — if Write throws, the ledger is not updated. Both paths now contribute to the ledger.

---

### 3. New file: `+tests/VisualRelay.Tests/ObsidianExportLedgerTests.cs` (~260 lines)

Plain `[Fact]` tests (no Avalonia dependency). Tests the `ExportLedger` class in isolation.

Test scenarios:
1. **`ContainsAsync_ReturnsFalse_WhenLedgerAbsent`** — no file → false.
2. **`ContainsAsync_ReturnsTrue_AfterRecord`** — record, then contains → true.
3. **`RecordAsync_IsIdempotent`** — record same id twice, ledger has one entry.
4. **`RecordBatchAsync_AddsAllIds`** — batch of 3, all present.
5. **`TrySeedAsync_ReturnsSkip_WhenLedgerExists`** — pre-create valid ledger → Skip.
6. **`TrySeedAsync_ReturnsFullBackfill_WhenNoLedgerAndNoNotes`** — no ledger, empty Completed/ → FullBackfill, empty ledger file created.
7. **`TrySeedAsync_ReturnsSealOnly_WhenNoLedgerButNotesExist`** — create a Completed/ subfolder with a `.md` note file, no ledger → SealOnly, ledger seeded with all provided ids.
8. **`TrySeedAsync_CorruptLedgerTreatedAsAbsent_FullBackfill`** — corrupt JSON in ledger file, no notes → FullBackfill (not crash).
9. **`RecordAsync_OverwritesCorruptLedger`** — corrupt file, record a task → file becomes valid JSON with that task.
10. **`AtomicSave_NoPartialWrite`** — verify no `.tmp` file remains after save; verify content is complete.

Uses `TempDirectory` from `TestFileSystem` for setup/teardown. Creates a minimal `ObsidianVaultLayout` for tests that need it.

---

### 4. New file: `+tests/VisualRelay.Tests/ObsidianBridgeExportGateTests.cs` (~260 lines)

`[AvaloniaFact]` + `[Collection("Headless")]` tests. Full VM integration through `RunObsidianBridgeScanAsync`.

Test scenarios (mapped to requirements):
1. **`Scan_NoRelayDir_WritesNoNote`** — completed task with `DONE-<id>.md` but no `.relay/<id>/` directory anywhere → run scan → no note in Completed/, ledger does not contain id. (Fixes defect 1 — fails today.)
2. **`Scan_MetriclessTask_TwoUtcDays_ZeroNotes`** — completed task with `.relay/<id>/` directory but zero stage reports → run scan at day 1 with a `ManualTimeProvider` controlling `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow`, advance 24h, scan again → zero notes both days. (Fixes defect 2 — fails today.)
3. **`Scan_DeletedNote_NotRecreated`** — completed task with stage reports → run scan (note created, ledger seeded) → delete the note file → run scan again → note NOT recreated. (Fixes defect 3 — fails today.)
4. **`Scan_FreshVault_BackfillsAllMetricHavingTasks`** — multiple completed tasks with stage reports at varying dates, no ledger, no Completed/ notes → run scan → every metric-having task gets a note at its metric-derived date, ledger contains all ids. (Pins load-bearing population.)
5. **`Scan_PreLedgerVault_SeedsWithoutWriting`** — completed tasks with stage reports, pre-create Completed/ notes (simulating pre-ledger vault), no ledger → run scan → no new notes written, ledger contains all completed ids. (Fails today — missing notes get back-filled.)
6. **`ExportSummaryOnCompletion_RecordsInLedger`** — directly call `ExportSummaryOnCompletion` (via reflection or internal accessor) → ledger contains the task id. (Completion-time path recorded.)
7. **`Scan_CorruptLedger_FullBackfillApplies`** — write corrupt JSON to `.vr-export-ledger.json`, no Completed/ notes → run scan → back-fill proceeds (not crash, corrupt treated as absent).

Uses the same `SetupDirs`/`CreateViewModel` patterns from `ObsidianBridgeVmScaffoldExportTests.cs`. Uses `ManualTimeProvider` for time-dependent tests (scenario 2).

---

### Verification checklist

- `./visual-relay check` fully green including all new tests.
- Red-first: new tests fail before the implementation changes, pass after.
- Manual: scratch repo + vault:
  1. Fresh vault scan populates notes + ledger.
  2. Delete a note, rescan → stays deleted.
  3. Archive a task by hand with no `.relay/<id>`, rescan across simulated day change → no note.
  4. Delete ledger, rescan → no new notes, ledger reseeded.
